pick_order.numbering_note: A keeper occupies his pick slot; the pick is not removed and nothing after it shifts up. Verified against seasons 2023/2024/2025 in league_history: 150 picks and round 4 at overall 31 every year, with 0, 23 and 20 keepers respectively. `picks` is the BOARD (depth: how many players leave the pool). `live_picks` is how many SELECTIONS happen. They differ by the keeper count and conflating them is a real defect this carries both to prevent.
